[[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] '''Holographic Interface''' technology was a form of piloting and system interface technology used heavily by the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]]. Consisting of comprehensive [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] readouts and [[Heads-up display/Legends|heads up displays]], when activated the system would envelop the hands of the user in holographic spheres - hand gestures and motions would then control the craft or system in question. This system was extremely hard to use without training, as shown by [[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase]] when he flew an [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|Umbaran starfighter]].

This technology was used extensively in the hi-tech [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|Umbaran starfighter]], [[Umbaran hover tank/Legends|hovertank]], and [[Umbaran/Legends|mobile heavy cannons]].
